Aria Icons.text_pairing: Match a text-paired icon's optical height (actual visible ink) to the label's cap height at its font, size and weight. Center icon and label vertically. Balance leading and trailing slots to keep the label centered within the whole button. Do not match the icon frame to the font size or line height. In button-local coordinates from the top-left, leading visible-ink center = (buttonHeight / 2, buttonHeight / 2); trailing visible-ink center = (buttonWidth - buttonHeight / 2, buttonHeight / 2). Each matches the rounded endcap center, as if an invisible circle of diameter buttonHeight occupied that end. Position visible ink, not just its frame. Keep the whole label centered at (buttonWidth / 2, buttonHeight / 2) with balanced end slots and icon ink sized to label cap height. The circle is a placement guide; draw no extra circle or border.

sources.title: Design for TV
sources.application: Keep the TV experience glanceable at about 3 m / 10 ft, with short text and immediate remote feedback.

sources.title: Focus system
sources.application: Distinguish focused and pressed states from persistent selection. Keep one focus target in the implementation. Kozu uses native tone/lift/scale without outer state borders; reduced motion uses static tone and text weight.

sources.title: Navigation on TV
sources.application: Use spatial D-pad paths, Select to activate, and remote Back to return. Preserve the originating focus target; do not duplicate remote Back onscreen or gate exit.

sources.title: Typography
sources.application: Use Source Serif 4 (internal RR Serif) for headings and Inter for body and controls. Preserve distant readability; native platform typography may override these defaults.

sources.title: Layouts
sources.application: Use a 16:9 TV canvas, aligned spatial groups, and approximately 5% safety margins; let background artwork extend beyond safe content.

sources.title: Buttons
sources.application: Use clear action labels, fully rounded action containers and icon buttons for compact actions. Apply the Kozu text-button rule: Inter 22 like top categories; actual icon ink matches label cap height, both center vertically, and balanced icon slots keep the label centered within the whole button. Retain large hit areas. In button-local coordinates from the top-left, leading visible-ink center = (buttonHeight / 2, buttonHeight / 2); trailing visible-ink center = (buttonWidth - buttonHeight / 2, buttonHeight / 2). Each matches the rounded endcap center, as if an invisible circle of diameter buttonHeight occupied that end. Position visible ink, not just its frame. Keep the whole label centered at (buttonWidth / 2, buttonHeight / 2) with balanced end slots and icon ink sized to label cap height. The circle is a placement guide; draw no extra circle or border.

sources.title: Cards
sources.application: Use one content item per aligned card. Kozu uses full-bleed 16:9 imagery and an overlaid bottom-up dark scrim for titles and metadata, without an inset thumbnail.

sources.title: Apple HIG — Focus and selection
sources.application: Allow room for native tvOS focus enlargement and lift without covering nearby content. Keep focus separate from persistent selection. Kozu omits outer focus/state borders.

sources.title: Apple HIG — Tab bars
sources.application: Use the tvOS top navigation pattern as a reference. Kozu centers one top destination row; preserve native remote navigation and focus return in the implementation.

sources.title: Apple HIG — Accessibility
sources.application: Check foreground/background contrast over actual imagery and honor Reduce Motion. Kozu requires at least 4.5:1 for card titles and metadata; reduced-motion focus uses static tone and text weight without animated zoom, scale or parallax.

sources.title: Apple HIG — Layout
sources.application: Apple gives 80 pt side and 60 pt top/bottom safe-area guidance. At 1920 width, the 72-unit side inset in the 1440-wide Kozu preview maps to 96 pt. Verify vertical safe areas separately; native framework bounds and focus geometry are authoritative.

typefaces.heading: Source Serif 4 (actual native family: RR Serif)

adaptation.palette: Tailwind Slate 50 / 950; blue selection, violet category, teal completion, rose error
adaptation.focus: No outer state, focus, selected or pressed borders. Native tone/lift/scale identifies focus; selection retains tint/checkmarks and semantics. Reduced motion uses static tone and text weight, with no animated zoom, scale or parallax.
adaptation.source_interpretation: Centered navigation, card dimensions, scrim stops, fonts, palette and selection colors are Kozu adaptations inspired by tvOS and Android TV, not universal platform requirements. The 1.5 design-units-per-dp value describes the original Android drawing scale, not a cross-platform unit conversion.
adaptation.navigation: One tvOS-inspired centered top destination row. Contextual actions apply to the current content; do not duplicate destinations.

cards.image: Full bleed to every card edge; no inset thumbnail or separate opaque metadata panel.
cards.scrim: Bottom-up black gradient: transparent through 25% of card height, 82% opacity at 60%, 94% opacity at the bottom.
cards.text_placement: Titles and metadata below 60% of card height.
cards.contrast: Require at least 4.5:1 for titles and metadata against the actual composited image at every supported state and crop. Strengthen the scrim or use an opaque fallback if necessary; the gradient recipe alone does not prove contrast.
cards.reduced_motion: Static tone and text weight at the unfocused size; no animated zoom, scale or parallax.

adaptation.safe_area_interpretation: Preview coordinates are 1440×810. The 72-unit side inset maps to 96 pt at 1920 width, exceeding Apple’s 80 pt side guidance. The existing vertical preview inset is not a claim of tvOS safe-area compliance. Use native framework safe areas and focus geometry; verify top/bottom clearance separately.

text_buttons.reference: Same label size as the top categories.
text_buttons.paired_icon: Match a text-paired icon's optical height (actual visible ink) to the label's cap height at its font, size and weight. Center icon and label vertically. In button-local coordinates from the top-left, leading visible-ink center = (buttonHeight / 2, buttonHeight / 2); trailing visible-ink center = (buttonWidth - buttonHeight / 2, buttonHeight / 2). Each matches the rounded endcap center, as if an invisible circle of diameter buttonHeight occupied that end. Position visible ink, not just its frame. Keep the whole label centered at (buttonWidth / 2, buttonHeight / 2) with balanced end slots and icon ink sized to label cap height. The circle is a placement guide; draw no extra circle or border.

icon_source.preservation: Preserve semantic icon strokes and checkmarks when removing outer state borders.

design_decisions.dimensions: Each page contains one native 1600 × 1300 frame. Round specimens are 320 × 320 logical units. Apple display specimens are 280 × 352 logical units. These are representative drawing bounds; they are neither universal device dp/pt sizes nor physical pixels.
design_decisions.typography: Source Serif 4 (installed internal family RR Serif) is the core heading font; Inter is the core body/control font. Compact watch labels, dates, metadata, list titles and complication values use Inter for short-form legibility. Face time and larger headings use RR Serif. Native platform APIs may impose system typography, particularly tiles and complications.
design_decisions.color: Tailwind Slate 50 #F8FAFC and Slate 950 #020617 anchor light documentation and dark watch content. Blue is primary action, violet is secondary emphasis and teal is selection/active content. Green success, amber warning and rose error each include text and an icon.
design_decisions.selection: Selected icon and container resolve from the same app accent, with tint/checkmarks, text weight and selected semantics. Pressed controls use tone/fill. No outer state, focus, selected or pressed borders. Focus uses native tone/lift/scale independently from selection; reduced motion uses static tone and text weight without animated zoom, scale or parallax.
design_decisions.materials: Wear OS and Android home widgets exclude portable backdrop blur by default; use native tonal surfaces. Apple widgets use host-provided glass only in supported appearances, with full-color and accessibility fallbacks. Other supported app controls use blur 28 and transient overlays blur 40 only after contrast and performance checks; opaque fallbacks remain required.
design_decisions.geometry: Icons use the supplied Aria-distributed Lucide SVG source at 24 logical units, with native 1.8-unit strokes. Preserve semantic icon strokes and checkmarks. Circular controls have centered 24-unit icons; nested curved surfaces remain concentric. Apple display corner radius is 52; a uniform 12-unit inset would use radius 40. For text-paired icons, match actual ink height to label cap height and center both vertically; balance slots to keep the label centered within the whole button. Retain native touch targets and icon-only defaults. In button-local coordinates from the top-left, leading visible-ink center = (buttonHeight / 2, buttonHeight / 2); trailing visible-ink center = (buttonWidth - buttonHeight / 2, buttonHeight / 2). Each matches the rounded endcap center, as if an invisible circle of diameter buttonHeight occupied that end. Position visible ink, not just its frame. Keep the whole label centered at (buttonWidth / 2, buttonHeight / 2) with balanced end slots and icon ink sized to label cap height. The circle is a placement guide; draw no extra circle or border.
design_decisions.touch: Most control targets are 48–64 logical units; shared capsule controls are 56 units tall. Android runtime targets must meet 48 dp. Apple recommends 44 pt default controls; this reference uses a more generous shared 48-unit floor.
design_decisions.native_editability: All authored objects are native frames, components, instances, text, vector paths, ellipses and semantic color variables. No page is a flattened image.
design_decisions.native_scroll_and_text: Use native ScreenScaffold, TransformingLazyColumn, SurfaceTransformation and bezel-following EdgeButton. Rows and their text transform together; EdgeButton text follows native reveal height. Do not add delayed custom text fades or a separate scroll entrance delay. FadingExpandingLabel is for changing multiline content only. Respect LocalReduceMotion and native typography, touch and rotary behavior; FigCraft motion previews are simulations.
